services_host.description: The hostname that Anope will be seen as and used in defines.

uplink_host.description: The IP address, hostname, or UNIX socket path of the IRC server to connect to.

uplink_protocol.description: The protocol Anope uses when connecting to the uplink (ipv4, ipv6, unix).

uplink_ssl.description: Enable SSL connection to the uplink.

uplink_port.description: The port to connect to on the IRCd.

uplink_password.description: The password to send to the IRC server for authentication.

server_description.description: The text which appears as the server's information in /WHOIS.

pid_file.description: The filename containing the Anope process ID.

protocol_module.description: The IRCd Protocol module to speak when connecting.

network_name.description: The name of the network Anope is running on.

casemap.description: The case mapping used by services.

badpasslimit.description: Number of invalid password tries before a user is removed.

badpasstimeout.description: Time after which invalid passwords are forgotten about.

expiretimeout.description: Delay between checks for expired nicknames and channels.

readtimeout.description: Timeout period for reading from the uplink.

warningtimeout.description: Interval between sending warning messages for program errors.

timeoutcheck.description: Frequency at which the timeout list is checked.

retrywait.description: Time to wait between connection retries with the uplink(s).

hideprivilegedcommands.description: Hide commands users don't have privilege to execute from HELP.

hideregisteredcommands.description: Hide commands users can't execute because they are not logged in from HELP.

didyoumeandifference.description: Maximum difference between an invalid and valid command name to allow as a suggestion.

languages.default: ca_ES.UTF-8 de_DE.UTF-8 el_GR.UTF-8 es_ES.UTF-8 fr_FR.UTF-8 hu_HU.UTF-8 it_IT.UTF-8 nl_NL.UTF-8 pl_PL.UTF-8 pt_PT.UTF-8 ru_RU.UTF-8 tr_TR.UTF-8
languages.description: Space-separated list of languages to load on startup.

log_target.description: Target(s) to log to (channel, filename, or globops).

log_bot.description: The bot used to log generic messages.

log_logage.description: Number of days to keep log files.

log_rawio.description: Log raw input and output from services.

oper_require_oper.description: If set, the user must be an oper on the IRCd to gain their oper privileges.

mail_sendfrom.description: The email address from which all emails are sent.

mail_delay.description: Minimum time a user must wait before sending another email.

db_module_name.description: The database module to load (e.g., db_flatfile, db_sql).

db_database.description: The database file name or engine identifier.

db_keepbackups.description: Number of days backups of databases are kept.

db_fork.description: Fork a child process to save databases.

db_engine.description: The SQL service or database engine to use.

db_import.description: Import data from another database module on startup.
